report.answer_text:
Tilman Fertitta, a Houston billionaire, owns the Golden Nugget Atlantic City through his company. Fertitta Entertainment, owned by Tilman Fertitta, has subsidiaries that include Landry's, Inc., the Houston Rockets and the Golden Nugget casinos.[1] Landry's, Inc. is the entity that holds the property directly. Landry's took control of the property on May 23, 2011, and renamed it the Golden Nugget Atlantic City.[2] It was previously Trump Marina.
Two recent developments:
Caesars deal: Fertitta Entertainment will pay $5.7 billion to acquire Caesars Entertainment, which owns Harrah's, the Tropicana and Caesars Atlantic City.[3] Because Fertitta already owns Golden Nugget Atlantic City, the combined company will control four casino hotels at the Jersey Shore.[3] The search results don't say whether the deal has closed. A shareholder vote was scheduled, so check for the latest status.
Ambassador role: Fertitta said he would resign as CEO if confirmed as U.S. ambassador to Italy.[4] A related headline says New Jersey casino regulators approved his ex-wife to run his company while he serves as ambassador.[4] Day-to-day leadership may therefore differ from ownership.
